# Elkholy Consulting
> Independent medical cost containment for Egyptian hospital claims. A physician and former
> hospital medical director on Egypt's Red Sea coast reviews Egyptian hospital invoices for
> international insurers and assistance companies, before settlement. Paid only as a share of
> what he removes from the bill, never a percentage of the invoice.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://elkholy-consulting.com/): the offer, the five-phase ladder, contact
- [Specimen review report](https://elkholy-consulting.com/specimen/): the exact deliverable, illustrated
- [Due diligence, answered](https://elkholy-consulting.com/due-diligence/): vendor-review questions answered
- [GOP checklist](https://elkholy-consulting.com/gop-checklist/): six clauses for guarantees of payment

## Field notes (analysis)
- [The engagement, what one reader delivers](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/the-engagement/): the insider moat, a phased engagement, why one reader beats a department
- [The philosophy of cost containment](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/philosophy-of-cost-containment/): THE essay; Arrow, Akerlof, DRGs, Goodhart, anchoring, repeated games, five principles
- [The economics of a Red Sea claim](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/red-sea-claim-economics/): tourism volumes, currency collapse, invoice anatomy
- [Egyptian prices: economics, not fraud](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/egyptian-prices-economics-not-fraud/): the touristic fee, layer by layer
- [Why Egyptian hospital bills run high](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/why-egyptian-hospital-bills-run-high/): precedent files and service percentages
- [Why a TPA fails at cost containment](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/why-tpa-fails-at-cost-containment/): incentives and the false-security effect
- [Five incentive lines in your claims chain](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/five-incentives-in-your-claims-chain/): the alignment test
- [The discount illusion](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/the-discount-illusion/): why a percentage off an asking price is not a saving
- [The anatomy of a guarantee of payment](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/anatomy-of-a-guarantee-of-payment/): how hospitals read your GOP
- [Managing a case from 3,000 kilometres](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/managing-cases-from-3000-kilometres/): the information problem
- [Treat in Egypt or repatriate?](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/treat-in-egypt-or-repatriate/): the fork that sets the whole cost
- [How to verify an Egyptian hospital invoice](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/verify-egyptian-hospital-invoice/): five practical checks
- [What is a payer precedent file?](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/payer-precedent-file/): the record kept on every payer
- [Reasonable and customary, with no tariff](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/reasonable-and-customary-in-egypt/): three reference points that hold
- [The ICU day](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/icu-day-billing/): the most expensive line and the step-down question
- [Diving claims on the Red Sea](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/diving-claims-red-sea/): reading the hyperbaric invoice
- [The quiet lines: pharmacy and consumables](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/pharmacy-and-consumables/): four growth patterns
- [The winter wave](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/red-sea-winter-wave/): seasonality and the September checklist
- [The repatriation ladder](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/repatriation-ladder/): escort, stretcher, air ambulance
- [The admission conversion](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/outpatient-to-inpatient/): how outpatient visits become inpatient files
- [The deposit despite your guarantee](https://elkholy-consulting.com/notes/cash-deposit-despite-guarantee/): how a desk re-prices its paper
